fullContentHtml:
The All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS) has released an official notification for the Common Recruitment Examination (CRE-5)-2026 on its official website. A total of 1484 vacancies have been announced for the AIIMS CRE 2026 Exam this year. Candidates willing to apply for various Group B and C posts in AIIMS can apply online from 13th June to 3rd July 2026. Interested candidates are advised to check the complete eligibility criteria before applying for the AIIMS CRE 5 Recruitment 2026. Scroll down to get complete information on recruitment, vacancies, eligibility, application fee, selection process and the application process.

AIIMS CRE Notification 2026 Out

The AIIMS CRE 5 Notification 2026 has been released by the All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS), New Delhi. Candidates who have completed Matriculation/10th grade, ITI/trade certificates, graduation, or postgraduation can apply for various Group B and C posts, as per their eligibility requirements.The The detailed AIIMS CRE Notification PDF has been uploaded on the official website along with apply online link. Download the AIIMS CRE 5 Recruitment Notice PDF from the link given below to check the eligibility, selection process, application online, vacancy, syllabus and more.

AIIMS CRE 5 Notification 2026 (Official PDF): Download Here

AIIMS CRE Recruitment 2026: Overview

Before releasing the official notification, AIIMS usually releases a notification to inform candidates about the upcoming recruitment process. Check more details below.

Particulars Details

Exam Name AIIMS CRE 5
Vacancy 1484
Post Various Non-Faculty Group-B and Group-C posts (57 Groups)
Application Start Date 13th June 2026
Last Date to Apply 3rd July 2026
Application Status Released
Level of Exam National
Frequency of Exam As per requirement
Exam Stages
  1. Computer-Based Test (CBT)

AIIMS CRE 5 Notification 2026: Important Dates

The All India Institute of Medical Sciences has released the complete application and exam schedule for candidates to apply for the recruitment accordingly. Check the important dates regarding the AIIMS recruitment 2026 below.

Events Dates

AIIMS CRE 5 Online Registration Starts 13th June 2026
Last Date to Apply 3rd July 2026
Submission of NOC (for govt./PSU/autonomous body employees) 8th July 2026
Status of Application Acceptance Published 11th July 2026
CBT Exam Date (Tentative) 25th to 27th July 2026
Admit Card Release Date 2nd week of July 2026
Skill Test Date To be Announced

AIIMS CRE 5 Vacancy 2026

The AIIMS CRE 5 Recruitment 2026 has announced a total of 1,484 vacancies for various Group B and Group C posts. These vacancies are available across 20 AIIMS institutes and several other Central Government organizations, including ICMR, CNCI Kolkata, RML Hospital, LHMC, RIPANS Aizawl, AIIMS-CAPFIMS and the Pasteur Institute of India. Candidates can check the post wise and category wise vacancies in the detailed notification.

AIIMS CRE Mock Test: Click to Attempt

AIIMS CRE 5 Apply Online 2026

The AIIMS CRE 2026 online application link has been activated on the official AIIMS CRE recruitment portal. Eligible candidates can visit @aiimsexams.ac.in and complete their registration for Group-B and Group-C non-faculty posts. They must note that the application can be submitted online only. Candidates are advised to complete the online registration process before deadline i.e. 3rd July 2026. Click on the link below to start the application process process.

AIIMS CRE 5 Apply Online 2026 (Link Active): Click to Apply

How to Apply Online for AIIMS CRE 5 Recruitment 2026?

Candidates can apply online for AIIMS CRE 5 Recruitment 2026 through the official AIIMS website. Follow the steps below to complete the application process:

  1. Visit the official AIIMS website.
  2. Complete the registration by entering your basic details, mobile number, email ID and other information.
  3. A unique Registration ID will be sent to your registered email ID and mobile number.
  4. Log in using the Registration ID and fill out the application form with your educational and personal details.
  5. Upload your photograph, signature and thumb impression as per the given guidelines.
  6. Pay the application fee online according to your category.
  7. Carefully review all the details entered in the application form before final submission.
  8. Submit the form and download a copy of the completed application form for future reference.

AIIMS CRE Application Fees 2026

Candidates applying for AIIMS CRE 2026 have to pay the application fee according to their category. The application fee is generally non-refundable. However SC/ST candidates will receive a refund after the declaration of results.

Category Application Fee Payment Method
General/OBC Candidates Rs. 3000/- Debit Card, Credit Card, Net Banking
SC/ST/EWS Candidates Rs. 2400/- Debit Card, Credit Card, Net Banking
Persons with Disabilities (PwD) Exempted –

AIIMS CRE 5 Selection Process

The AIIMS CRE 2026 recruitment process for various Group B and Group C posts is based on the post applied for. However candidates will have to go through multiple stages before final selection.

  • Computer-Based Test: This will have 100 objective type questions carrying 400 marks.
  • Skill Test: It is conducted for specific posts only to check practical skills.
  • Document Verification: It includes verification of original documents related to education, age, category and other requirements.

Note: The final selection is based on performance in the required stages and successful document verification.

AIIMS CRE 5 Notification 2026 FAQs

Q. When is AIIMS CRE 5 Notification 2026 released?

The AIIMS CRE 5 Notification 2026 has been released on 13th June on the official website.

Q. When is the last date to apply for AIIMS CRE Recruitment?

The last date to apply for AIIMS CRE 5 Recruitment 2026 is 3rd July f2026.

Q. How many vacancies have been announced for AIIMS CRE 2026?

A total of 1484 vacancies have been announced for AIIMS CRE 5 Recruitment 2026.

Q. What is the AIIMS CRE selection process?

Candidates are selected on the basis of written exam, skill test and document verification.

Q. When is AIIMS CRE 5 Exam 2026?

The AIIMS CRE Exam 2026 is scheduled to be held on 25-27 July 2026.
